name: Xvivo Perfusion AB (publ)
summary: Xvivo Perfusion AB (publ), a medical technology company, develops and markets machines and perfusion solutions for assessing usable organs and maintains in optimal condition pending transplantation in Sweden. It operates through Thoracic; Abdominal; Services; and other segments.
